description: This file defines the MultiRetrievalQAChain_Chains class implementing the INode interface, which manages a multi-retrieval question-answering chain using langchain components. It includes methods for initialization and execution, handling moderation, streaming responses, and integrating multiple retrievers.

classes.name: MultiRetrievalQAChain_Chains
classes.description: Implements a node for multi-retrieval QA chain, managing initialization and run logic, including moderation and streaming.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the node with labels, inputs, and description.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Sets up the chain with provided node data, including retrievers and model.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the chain with input, handling moderation, streaming, and response formatting.
